title: Past perfect · 过去完成时
pattern: Subject + had + Past participle (earlier past)  ·  Past simple (later past)
summary: 过去完成时表示“过去的过去”：先发生的动作用 had + V3，后发生的动作用一般过去时。
explanation: **过去完成时** had + V3 用来回顾比另一个过去时间点更早发生的动作：When I arrived, the film **had already started**.（我到的时候，电影已经开始了。）它的作用是给“过去的过去”加上一个时间标记。
当一句话里出现两个过去动作时，先发生的用过去完成时，后发生的用一般过去时：She **had finished** her homework before she **went** out. 如果 before、after、when 等词已经把先后顺序说得很清楚，口语中也常只用一般过去时：She finished her homework, then went out.
常和过去完成时搭配的词有 by the time（到……的时候）、already、just、never、before、until 等：By the time we got to the station, the train **had left**. 注意这些词通常放在 had 之后、过去分词之前。
中文常说“我到的时候他已经走了”，英语只需要把“走了”改成 had left，不需要额外加词。中文不区分两个过去动作的先后，英语却会明确地用 had + V3 标出先发生的那个动作。
写作和正式表达中，如果两件事的先后顺序需要强调，一定要使用过去完成时。例如 After he **had eaten**, he went to bed. 这样读者一眼就能看出“先吃饭，后睡觉”。
mistakes: ✗ When I arrived, the film already started. → ✓ When I arrived, the film had already started. 中文的“已经开始了”容易漏掉 had，先发生的动作要用 had + V3。
✗ She had went home before the rain. → ✓ She had gone home before the rain. had 后面要接过去分词 gone，不能用过去式 went。
✗ When I got home, my parents had already ate dinner. → ✓ When I got home, my parents had already eaten dinner. ate 是过去式，过去分词是 eaten，不能混用。

examples.text: When I arrived, the film had already started.
examples.translation: 我到的时候，电影已经开始了。

examples.text: She had finished her homework before she went out.
examples.translation: 她出门之前已经写完了作业。

examples.text: By the time we got to the station, the train had left.
examples.translation: 我们到车站的时候，火车已经开走了。
examples.note: by the time 句型中常用过去完成时。

examples.text: After he had eaten, he went to bed.
examples.translation: 他吃完饭以后就去睡觉了。
examples.note: after 句中用过去完成时，先后关系更清楚。

examples.text: I had never seen snow before I moved to Harbin.
examples.translation: 搬到哈尔滨之前，我从来没见过雪。

examples.text: The shop had closed, so we went home.
examples.translation: 商店已经关门了，所以我们回家了。

exercises.sentence: When I arrived, the meeting had already ___.
exercises.translation: 我到的时候，会议已经开始了。
options: start
starting
begin
begun
exercises.explanation: had + 过去分词，begin 的过去分词是 begun。

exercises.source: 我们到达的时候，火车已经开走了。
options: When we arrived, the train has left.
When we arrived, the train was leaving.
When we arrived, the train had left.
When we arrived, the train had leave.
exercises.explanation: “已经开走了”发生在过去的“到达”之前，应用过去完成时 had left。

options: He had left before I arrived.
She had did her homework before dinner.
They had seen the film already.
exercises.explanation: had 后面要接过去分词 done，应改为 She had done her homework before dinner。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我打电话的时候她已经走了。
exercises.explanation: 先发生的动作 had already left 放在 when 从句所表示的过去时间之前。

exercises.sentence: When the teacher came in, the students ___ their tests.
exercises.translation: 老师走进来的时候，学生们已经做完了试卷。
options: had finished
finishing
finish
has finished
exercises.explanation: “做完”发生在老师进来之前，用过去完成时 had finished。

exercises.source: 商店已经关门了，所以我们回家了。
options: The shop had closed, so we went home.
The shop is closed, so we went home.
The shop was closing, so we went home.
The shop closes, so we went home.
exercises.explanation: 关门发生在“我们回家”之前，应用 had closed。

exercises.sentence: The baby ___ asleep when I got home.
exercises.translation: 我到家的时候，宝宝已经睡着了。
options: has fallen
falling
had fallen
fall
exercises.explanation: “睡着”发生在我到家之前，应使用过去完成时 had fallen。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 他们以前从来没有见过雪。
exercises.explanation: never 放在 had 之后、过去分词 seen 之前。

options: The meal had been ready before the guests came.
I had met him once before the party.
We had went to the zoo before it rained.
exercises.explanation: had 后面要接过去分词 gone，应改为 We had been to the zoo before it rained。
